title: What agents know about the rikma
intro: When a member connects an AI agent to the rikma, this is what it is handed: who we are, what is happening now, and how work is done here. Members write the playbooks, and a change to them goes through the rikma like any other proposal.

playbook.heading: Playbooks
playbook.explain: What the data cannot say: how things are done here, why, and what we don't do. Every member's agents read them, so a change takes effect only by consent.
playbook.none: The rikma has no playbook yet. Write the first one; suggested sections are already in it.
playbook.noneRole: This role has no playbook yet.
playbook.consentNote: The text opens as a proposal to every member of the rikma. Your signature is already on it; it takes effect when everyone approves, or by silence when the rikma's clock runs out. A newer proposal for the same playbook replaces this one.
playbook.soloNote: You are the rikma's only member, so the text takes effect at once.
playbook.sent: Sent to the members. If nobody responds, silence approves it on {{when}}.
playbook.unchanged: That is exactly what it already says. Nothing was proposed.
playbook.failed: The proposal was not sent. Try again.
playbook.tooLong: A playbook is limited to {{count}} characters.
playbook.unavailable: We couldn't read the playbooks right now.

general.does: What the rikma does and why
general.whom: Who to turn to for what

role.promise: What may be promised without a vote, and what needs one
role.tools: Tools, channels and where things live

connect.heading: Connect an agent
connect.explain: A key that reaches this rikma only: the agent will not see your other rikmas. It acts as you, and nothing it prepares is signed without you.
connect.confirm: If you already created a key for this rikma, the old one will stop working. Continue?
connect.failed: We couldn't create a key. Try again.
connect.once: The key is shown only once. Copy it now.
connect.prompt: In a new conversation, pick the work-in-rikma prompt and the agent starts with the rikma's context already loaded.
connect.replaces: Creating a new key revokes the previous one.
connect.noGit: Never save the key in a file that goes into git.

personal.title: Your own connection: all your rikmas
personal.explain: The usual way. One connection for your agent, reaching every rikma you belong to, with each one's context. On claude.ai it is one click, with no key to copy.
personal.guide: The full guide for every agent
personal.cli: Claude Code and other agents: one terminal command
personal.thisRikma: To have the agent work in this rikma, pick the work-in-rikma prompt with rikma {{id}}, or simply ask it to work there.

scoped.title: Or: a key for this rikma only

preview.heading: What the agent sees
preview.explain: This is the answer an agent with a key for this rikma gets when it starts working here, with no focus.
preview.explainRole: This is the answer an agent gets when it works in the {{role}} role.
preview.failed: We couldn't assemble the context right now.
preview.denied: The context is not available to a key for this rikma.

draft.hint: The draft is written from what is already known about the rikma and what you wrote. Nothing is saved until you send.
draft.questions: Open questions in the draft (marked ❓): {{count}}. Answer or delete them before sending.
draft.rateLimited: You've reached the number of drafts for this hour. Try again later.
draft.denied: A draft can't be prepared for this rikma.
draft.failed: The draft wasn't written. Try again.
